[[File:Massassi_Ink_Rifle.png|thumb|right|250px|Massassi Ink Rifle]]
The '''Massassi Ink Rifle''' was a crafted [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] weapon developed by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] that resided on the moon of Yavin, [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Only a few examples of these weapons had survived into the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In appearance, they were a carved [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] which was mounted to a horn-shaped [[Stock/Legends|stock]] and was seemingly adapated to fit onto a scimitar. This allowed it to be used either as a long ranged rifle or as a melee weapon in close quarter combat. The ammunition consisted of a cartridge that was filled with a dark, viscous fluid which resembled ink but caused localized paralysis when it came into contact with flesh. Its effects were even more profound if the fluid struck the eyes of a target as it was capable of causing blindness.
